name: RT-1
summary: Robotics Transformer that tokenizes images + language into discrete actions; trained on 130k real demos.

name: RT-2
summary: Co-fine-tunes a web-scale VLM to emit actions as text tokens; the paper that popularised the term VLA.

name: RT-1-X / RT-2-X (Open X-Embodiment)
summary: RT-1/RT-2 trained on the pooled 22-embodiment Open X-Embodiment dataset to test cross-robot transfer.

name: Octo
summary: Open-source transformer diffusion policy pretrained on 800k OXE episodes; small enough to fine-tune on one GPU.

name: OpenVLA
org: Stanford, UC Berkeley, TRI, Google DeepMind
summary: 7B open VLA (Llama 2 + DINOv2/SigLIP) trained on 970k OXE episodes; the de-facto open baseline.

name: OpenVLA-OFT
summary: Optimized fine-tuning recipe (parallel decoding, action chunking, continuous L1 actions) for OpenVLA.

name: π0 (pi-zero)
summary: PaliGemma-based VLA with a flow-matching action expert for high-frequency dexterous control.

name: π0-FAST
summary: Autoregressive π0 variant using the FAST DCT-based action tokenizer.

name: π0.5
summary: Co-trained VLA aimed at open-world generalization (cleaning unseen homes); weights released in openpi.

name: GR00T N1 / N1.5
summary: Open humanoid foundation model with a VLM "System 2" and diffusion-transformer "System 1".

name: Gemini Robotics / Gemini Robotics-ER
summary: Gemini 2.0-based VLA plus an embodied-reasoning (ER) model for spatial understanding.

name: Gemini Robotics 1.5 / ER 1.5
summary: Thinking VLA + agentic ER model that plans multi-step tasks and transfers motions across embodiments.

name: Helix
summary: Dual-system VLA controlling a full humanoid upper body, announced via technical blog (no paper or weights).

name: SmolVLA
summary: 450M-parameter VLA trained on community LeRobot datasets; runs on consumer hardware.

name: RDT-1B
summary: 1.2B diffusion transformer foundation model for bimanual manipulation.

name: CogACT
summary: VLA that conditions a diffusion action transformer on VLM cognition features.

name: SpatialVLA
summary: Adds ego-centric 3D position encoding and adaptive spatial action grids to a VLA.

name: TinyVLA
org: Midea Group, East China Normal University
summary: Compact VLA with a diffusion policy decoder designed for fast inference and data efficiency.

name: DexVLA
summary: VLA with a 1B-parameter diffusion expert and embodiment curriculum for cross-embodiment dexterity.

name: HPT (Heterogeneous Pre-trained Transformers)
summary: Shared trunk with embodiment-specific stems/heads to pretrain across heterogeneous robots.

name: CrossFormer
summary: One transformer policy controlling arms, quadrupeds, drones and navigation robots.

name: RoboFlamingo
summary: Adapts the OpenFlamingo VLM to language-conditioned manipulation on CALVIN.

name: GR-1
summary: GPT-style model pretrained on large-scale video generation, then fine-tuned for manipulation.

name: GR-2
summary: Generative video-language-action model pretrained on 38M web video clips.

name: UniVLA
summary: Learns task-centric latent actions from videos to train cross-embodiment policies.

name: Magma
summary: Multimodal foundation model for both digital (UI) and physical (robot) agents.

name: GO-1 (Genie Operator-1)
summary: Generalist policy with latent action planner trained on the AgiBot World dataset.

name: Large Behavior Models (TRI)
summary: Careful statistical study of multitask diffusion "LBMs" with blind, randomized real-world evals.

name: PaLM-E
summary: 562B embodied multimodal language model feeding sensor tokens into PaLM for planning.

name: RoboCat
summary: Self-improving generalist agent that generates its own training data across arms.

name: Gato
summary: Single generalist transformer policy across games, captioning and real-robot stacking.

name: VIMA
summary: Multimodal-prompt manipulation agent with its own VIMA-Bench.

name: Hi Robot
summary: Hierarchical VLM high-level policy that handles open-ended instructions and corrections for a VLA.

name: Diffusion Policy
summary: Models action sequences with denoising diffusion; now a standard visuomotor baseline.

name: ACT / ALOHA
summary: Action Chunking with Transformers trained on low-cost bimanual ALOHA teleop data.

name: Mobile ALOHA
summary: Whole-body teleop + co-training for bimanual mobile manipulation.

name: 3D Diffusion Policy (DP3)
summary: Diffusion policy over compact point-cloud representations.

name: 3D Diffuser Actor
summary: 3D scene-token diffusion policy; strong on RLBench and CALVIN.

name: PerAct
summary: Perceiver transformer over voxelized observations for 6-DoF keyframe manipulation.

name: RVT-2
summary: Multi-view transformer for precise manipulation from few demonstrations.

name: Seer
summary: Predictive inverse dynamics model that jointly forecasts future frames and actions.

name: SERL
summary: Sample-efficient real-world RL software suite for manipulation.

name: HIL-SERL
summary: Human-in-the-loop real-world RL reaching near-perfect success on dexterous tasks.

name: Dobb-E
summary: Home-robot framework with a $20 "Stick" data collector and Home Pretrained Representations.

name: SayCan

name: Inner Monologue

name: Code as Policies

name: ProgPrompt
summary: Pythonic program prompts to generate situated robot task plans.

name: VoxPoser
summary: LLM+VLM compose 3D value maps that a motion planner follows zero-shot.

name: ReKep
summary: VLM-generated relational keypoint constraints solved as an optimization for manipulation.

name: LLM-Planner

name: Eureka

name: DrEureka

name: Text2Reward

name: Voyager

name: AutoRT
